faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Airports Authority of India (AAI) for engaging medical professionals at their regional facilities.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in AAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post is Medical Consultant (Non-Specialist Doctor) purely on a temporary basis at the Regional Head Quarters, Southern Region, Chennai.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Medical Consultant (Non-Specialist Doctor) position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS or equivalent degree from a recognized university as per MCI/Govt. of India norms with relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any work experience required to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants need at least 05 years of experience after graduation, including one year as a House Surgeon in a teaching institution.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Medical Consultant position is set at 60 years as per the notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or honorarium provided for this role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Rs.3000/- for the first 06 hours of duty inclusive of conveyance, and Rs.500/- for every additional hour.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the completed offline application form via speed post is 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for AAI Medical Consultant Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must download, fill out the form, and send it by post to the designated Chennai address.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this AAI healthcare job?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Medical Consultant position will be based on an interview conducted by the Airports Authority of India.
